_comment: Vanilla End biomes for the End-enclave seed. Paired with karos-terrain-overrides which: (a) prepends a surface rule painting end_stone on top of these biomes, (b) wraps final_density with the end_final function so the terrain is floating islands above a water column rather than vanilla overworld mountains. Sky stays overworld-coloured (vanilla End atmosphere requires the end dimension type) — but vanilla End-biome effects override sky/fog colour to dark, which is good enough.
